regression_risks: Links created before the change keep their stored EXPIRES_AT; only links created after deployment get the new default
Clients relying on the documented default (contract and spec A-006) see shorter or longer link lifetimes
Idempotent replays of a creation made before the change return the original link with its original expiry
rollout: Change the configured default and the documented default (contract description, spec A-006) in one approved change (C-005)
Deploy; the new default applies to links created afterwards, with no data migration
rollback: Restore the previous configured default and documentation; links created meanwhile keep the expiry they were given (not reversible for those links)
